200.answer: Q: What is a Modem? A: Device that allows you to connect to the Internet. Q: What is a Power cord? A: Small black cord with a round end which plugs into a power outlet and provides power to the modem. Q: How does this affect my services? A: Your services will be temporarily unavailable once you unplug the power cable. Q: What are we doing in these steps? A: We’re rebooting your modem to see if restarting your system will allow modem upgrades to install and solve your problem. Q: How do I perform Step 1? A: Locate your modem and remove the power cable from the back. Q: How do I perform Step 2? A: Wait 30 seconds and reconnect the power cable. Q: How do I perform Step 3? A: The lights on the front will blink as the modem goes through its startup routine. This can take up to five minutes.
